title: Why Stantec Stock Soared on Friday
author: Rich Smith
description: Stantec stock surged 12.95% after delivering a beat-and-raise quarter, earning Cdn$1.89 per share on Cdn$1.9 billion in revenue versus analyst expectations of Cdn$1.27 per share on Cdn$1.3 billion. The Canadian engineering firm reported 9% year-over-year sales growth and 24% adjusted earnings growth, with a contracted backlog growing 12% year-over-year, suggesting accelerating future growth. Management raised full-year guidance to 9-11% revenue growth and 17-19% adjusted earnings growth.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company beat analyst expectations on both sales and earnings, raised full-year guidance, demonstrated strong year-over-year growth in sales (9%), adjusted earnings (24%), and contracted backlog (12%), indicating accelerating future revenue growth. Stock soared 12.95% on the announcement.

title: Stantec (STN) Tops Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
author: Na
description: Stantec reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.35 per share, beating consensus estimates of $1.26, with revenues of $1.33 billion exceeding expectations. However, the stock has declined 20% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 11.3% gain. The company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions. Meanwhile, Maximus is expected to report quarterly earnings of $1.88 per share, representing 16.1% year-over-year growth, though revenues are projected to decline 1.8%.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Stantec beat earnings estimates by 7.14% and revenue expectations by 2.38%, the stock has significantly underperformed the market (down 20% YTD vs S&P 500 up 11.3%). The Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and mixed estimate revisions suggest neutral near-term performance expectations despite solid quarterly results.

Maximus is expected to report strong earnings growth of 16.1% year-over-year with consensus estimates unchanged over the last 30 days, indicating stable positive expectations. However, revenue is projected to decline 1.8%, which provides some offset to the positive earnings outlook.

title: Stantec reports third quarter 2026 results with strong net revenue growth and record adjusted EBITDA margin; raises profitability outlook
author: Na
description: Stantec delivered strong Q3 2026 results with net revenue of $1.9 billion (up 9.4% YoY), record adjusted EBITDA margin of 20.2% (up 120 basis points), and adjusted EPS of $1.89 (up 23.5%). The company raised its 2026 profitability guidance, expecting adjusted EBITDA margin of 18.3-18.5% and adjusted EPS growth of 17-19%. Contract backlog reached $9.2 billion, up 11.6% YoY, representing approximately 13 months of work.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stantec demonstrated strong financial performance with double-digit adjusted EPS growth (23.5%), record adjusted EBITDA margins, organic growth across all regions and businesses, and raised full-year profitability guidance. The company also maintains a healthy backlog of $9.2 billion representing 13 months of work, indicating strong future revenue visibility. Share repurchases and dividend increases further reflect management confidence.

title: Will Stantec (STN) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report?
author: Na
description: Stantec (STN), an engineering firm in the Consulting Services industry, has demonstrated a strong streak of beating earnings estimates in recent quarters, surpassing consensus by an average of 1.49%. With a positive Earnings ESP of +4.45% and a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), the company is positioned for another potential earnings beat in its November 12, 2026 report. Stocks combining positive Earnings ESP with a Zacks Rank #3 or better historically beat consensus estimates nearly 70% of the time.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stantec has a consistent track record of beating earnings estimates (averaging 1.49% above consensus in the last two quarters), a positive Earnings ESP of +4.45% indicating recent analyst bullishness, and a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). This combination historically produces earnings beats approximately 70% of the time, suggesting strong potential for another beat in the upcoming November 2026 report.

title: Stantec (STN) Earnings Expected to Grow: Should You Buy?
author: Na
description: Stantec is expected to report Q3 2026 earnings on November 12 with consensus estimates of $1.24 EPS (up 11.7% YoY) and $1.3B in revenues (up 5.1% YoY).
